risks.title: Rate limit bypass via IP spoofing
risks.detail: X-Forwarded-For header spoofing can bypass brute force protection. Requires attacker to be on same network or control proxy.

risks.title: GraphQL stack traces in development
risks.detail: NestJS returns stack traces in error responses when NODE_ENV is not 'production'

risks.title: JWT tokens stored in Redis without encryption
risks.detail: Refresh token hashes stored in Redis. If Redis is compromised, tokens could be used.
risks.mitigation: Redis should be on isolated network with AUTH

risks.title: No request size limits on GraphQL endpoint
risks.detail: GraphQL endpoint may accept large queries without depth limiting
risks.mitigation: Add GraphQL query depth and cost limiting
